source_claim: AlphaEvolve Section 3.3.2 states that the deployed Pallas tiling heuristic enhanced Gemini training efficiency and the Gemini team's research and engineering velocity; the Discussion frames this as a novel case where Gemini, through AlphaEvolve, optimized its own training process
claim_boundary: This boundary records that LibreEvolve can separately track Pallas kernel deployment and runtime evidence as prerequisites. It does not claim Gemini model-family identity, Gemini training workload identity, AlphaEvolve backend/model-family relation, optimized Pallas kernel id, production deployment or rollout state, deployment date or release window, before/after training time measurements, before/after kernel runtime measurements, training-efficiency deltas, research-velocity evidence, engineering-turnaround evidence, a self-optimization interpretation basis, causal linkage to the Gemini training pipeline, rollback/safety status, or team/owner confirmation.
